source_read: https://pepes.co.uk/nutrition-allergens-uk/ (live page, downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 with curl; robots.txt allows it) and read a second way: the saved page opened in Chromium and every card's rendered text (8 numbers + Allergens footer) dumped from the DOM
not_verifiable: the page prints no ingredient text, so allergen marks could only be compared with the page's own footer and with dish-name keywords (cheese/paneer, bread/wrap/burger, egg, fish, nuts: no conflict; Paneer Nachos prints milk but no wheat, an innocent corn-chip reading)
notes: The live page had drifted: it now has 153 cards (script knew 149): four new 'Current Promotion' melts (BBQ Chicken & Cheese Melt, BBQ Paneer & Cheese Melt, Chicken Cheese & Tomato Salsa Melt, Paneer Cheese & Tomato Salsa Melt; Gluten+Milk) were added to ROWS in pepes_piri_piri.py and the script re-run; the 149 existing cards are unchanged in every number and allergen. All 114 rows (calories, fat, saturates, carbs, sugars, protein, salt) and their allergens match the rendered cards. 2 more rows held back: Wings x 18 (salt 8.0 g) and Wings x 28 (salt 1.3 g) contradict each other and the 3- and 5-wing cards (0.1/0.2 g): size order inverted, neither chosen; Onion Rings was already held. 9 audit flags marked ok (platters/whole chicken protein and salt, Pepsi 1.5L sugar) with the card text as evidence. Remaining check_chain warning: Steamed Mixed Veg 106 kcal vs macros 86 (19%, vegetable fibre).
